query: The 2017–18 Wigan Athletic F.C. season will be a year in which the team competes in the league cup known as what for sponsorship reasons?

pipeline_result.response: The 2017–18 Wigan Athletic F.C. season will be a year in which the team competes in the league cup known as "Wigan Athletic Cup" (WC). This is because the team has been awarded sponsorship packages from various sponsors, including Wigan Football Club and Wigan Athletics.
